extra_vocab.note: 文中 Could the handlebar move back accidentally? 是在問握把會不會在沒人操作時不小心退回去，是對設計安全風險的確認。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: accidentally 是 accidental 加 -ly，拼成 -ally，不是 accidently。

example.en: I accidentally deleted the file from the shared folder.
example.zh: 我不小心把檔案從共用資料夾刪掉了。

example.en: Someone accidentally pressed the alarm button during the meeting.
example.zh: 有人在會議中不小心按到警報按鈕。

example.en: She accidentally sent the draft to the whole department.
example.zh: 她不小心把草稿寄給了整個部門。

examples.en: Sorry, I accidentally copied you on a private message.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我不小心把您加進了一封私人訊息的副本。

examples.en: The cover keeps the switch from being accidentally turned on.
examples.zh: 這個護蓋能避免開關被不小心打開。

examples.en: Our system accidentally charged some customers twice last week.
examples.zh: 我們的系統上週不小心對部分客戶重複收費。

confusable.diff: incidentally 是「順帶一提」，用來補充話題；accidentally 是「意外地」
confusable.usage: incidentally 多放在句首，用來順便補充訊息；accidentally 修飾動作，表示非故意。

example.en: Incidentally, the meeting has been moved to Friday morning.
example.zh: 順帶一提，會議已經改到週五早上。

similar.diff: by accident 是片語，通常放句尾，語氣較口語

example.en: The customer file was deleted by accident last night.
example.zh: 客戶檔案昨晚不小心被刪掉了。

similar.diff: unintentionally 較正式，強調不是有意的

example.en: The report unintentionally left out two key figures.
example.zh: 這份報告無意間漏掉了兩個關鍵數字。

example.en: He mistakenly sent the invoice to the wrong client.
example.zh: 他誤把發票寄給了錯的客戶。

example.en: The machine unexpectedly stopped during the final test.
example.zh: 機器在最後測試時意外停了下來。

derived.link: accident 是詞幹，指意外發生的事
accident + -al 變形容詞，像 national、personal；再加 -ly 變 accidentally

extra_vocab.en: done by hand and not by machine
extra_vocab.note: 文中 manual force 指不靠按鈕，而用人力施力把握把轉回去，與 automatic（自動）相對。manual 也可當名詞，指使用手冊。

example.en: The manuals are available in English and Chinese.
example.zh: 手冊有英文版和中文版。

example.en: The job involves heavy manual labor in the warehouse.
example.zh: 這份工作需要在倉庫做繁重的體力勞動。

example.en: The seat allows manual adjustment of height and angle.
example.zh: 這個座椅可手動調整高度與角度。

example.en: Please read the user manual before using the device.
example.zh: 使用裝置前請先閱讀使用手冊。

examples.en: The door can be opened by manual control if power fails.
examples.zh: 停電時，這扇門可用手動控制開啟。

examples.en: We are replacing manual data entry with an automatic system.
examples.zh: 我們正以自動系統取代人工輸入資料。

confusable.diff: annual 是「年度的」，拼法與發音和 manual 很像

example.en: The annual meeting will be held in March.
example.zh: 年度會議將在三月舉行。

confusable.diff: manufacture 是「製造」，與 manual 同源（manu- 是「手」）但意思不同

example.en: The company manufactures office chairs in southern Taiwan.
example.zh: 這家公司在台灣南部製造辦公椅。

similar.diff: by hand 是片語，修飾動作；manual 是形容詞，修飾名詞

example.en: These shipping labels are all filled in by hand.
example.zh: 這些出貨標籤全都是用手填寫的。

similar.diff: hands-on 指親自動手實作，不一定是沒有機械

example.en: The workshop includes hands-on practice with the equipment.
example.zh: 這個工作坊包含設備的實際操作練習。

example.en: The automatic door opens when someone approaches the entrance.
example.zh: 有人靠近入口時，自動門就會開啟。

example.en: Every new hire receives an employee handbook on the first day.
example.zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會拿到員工手冊。

example.en: The old machine requires a lot of manual adjustment.
example.zh: 這台舊機器需要大量手動調整。

example.en: The technician checked the manual before repairing the printer.
example.zh: 技術人員在修理印表機前先查閱了說明書。

extra_vocab.en: to put or use something, or to ask for something officially
extra_vocab.note: 文中 applying manual force 指「施加」人力把握把轉回去。多益中 apply 也常見「申請」(apply for) 與「適用」(apply to) 的用法，要靠介系詞分辨。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「申請」要用 apply for + 職位或許可，「向某人或機構申請／適用於」用 apply to；不能直接說 apply the job。

example.en: This discount applies to all orders over one hundred dollars.
example.zh: 這項折扣適用於所有超過一百美元的訂單。

example.en: Several candidates applied for the sales manager position.
example.zh: 有幾位應徵者申請了業務經理的職位。

example.en: Thank you for applying to our graduate program.
example.zh: 感謝您申請我們的研究所課程。

example.en: Do not apply too much force when closing the cover.
example.zh: 關上護蓋時請勿施加過大的力量。

example.en: You can apply for a refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 您可以在三十天內申請退款。

example.en: Please apply the member discount when you check out.
example.zh: 結帳時請套用會員折扣。

examples.en: Customers may apply the coupon to any item in the store.
examples.zh: 顧客可以把優惠券用在店內任何商品上。

examples.en: Please apply online before the position closes on Friday.
examples.zh: 請在職缺於週五截止前線上申請。

confusable.diff: supply 是「供應」，拼法的字尾 -ply 與 apply 相同

example.en: The factory supplies parts to three car makers.
example.zh: 這間工廠供應零件給三家汽車製造商。

confusable.diff: reply 是「回覆」，字尾 -ply 與 apply 相同，容易看錯

example.en: Please reply to this email by noon today.
example.zh: 請在今天中午前回覆這封電子郵件。

similar.diff: exert 較正式，多用於施加力量或影響；apply 範圍更廣

example.en: Don't exert too much force on the glass panel.
example.zh: 請不要對玻璃面板施加太大的力。

similar.diff: use 是一般的「使用」；apply 常指把東西塗上或施加

example.en: Use a soft cloth to clean the screen carefully.
example.zh: 請用軟布小心清潔螢幕。

example.en: You may request a larger size at no cost.
example.zh: 您可以免費要求更大的尺寸。

example.en: Please submit your form to the front desk today.
example.zh: 請今天把表格交到櫃檯。

derived.link: apply 去 y 加 -ication，像 simplify → simplification
apply + -ance，名詞字尾，指被拿來使用的器具

senses.en: to put force or a substance onto something
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 force、pressure、label 等，表示「施加或貼上」

example.en: Apply the label evenly to the front of the box.
example.zh: 請把標籤平整地貼在箱子正面。

senses.en: to ask officially for a job, permit, or approval
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 apply for + 職位 / 許可

example.en: Employees must apply for vacation at least a week early.
example.zh: 員工必須至少提前一週申請休假。

senses.en: to be relevant to a person or situation
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 apply to + 人 / 情況

example.en: These safety rules apply to everyone on the factory floor.
example.zh: 這些安全規定適用於工廠現場的每個人。

extra_vocab.en: to say that something is good or should be done
extra_vocab.note: 文中 Which option would you recommend 是聽眾請說話者在目前設計與替代方案之間選一個並給出建議，是簡報問答常見的問法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: recommend 後接 V-ing 或 that + 子句（that 後的動詞用原形）；不說 recommend someone to V。

example.en: Our manager recommends booking the venue at least a month ahead.
example.zh: 我們的經理建議至少提前一個月預訂場地。

example.en: The consultant recommended a new supplier for the parts.
example.zh: 顧問推薦了一家新的零件供應商。

example.en: Please read the recommended settings before installing the software.
example.zh: 安裝軟體前，請先閱讀建議的設定。

example.en: I am recommending this hotel for the client dinner.
example.zh: 我要推薦這間飯店來辦客戶晚宴。

example.en: I highly recommend the seafood restaurant near the convention center.
example.zh: 我強力推薦會議中心附近那家海鮮餐廳。

example.en: Could you recommend a solution to the shipping delay?
example.zh: 你能針對運送延遲建議一個解決方案嗎？

example.en: We recommend that all staff update their passwords.
example.zh: 我們建議所有員工更新密碼。

examples.en: Could you recommend a reliable printing company in Taipei?
examples.zh: 你能推薦一家台北可靠的印刷公司嗎？

examples.en: Our agent can recommend a plan that fits your budget.
examples.zh: 我們的專員可以推薦符合您預算的方案。

confusable.diff: commend 是「稱讚、表揚」，不是「推薦」

example.en: The director commended the team for finishing early.
example.zh: 主任稱讚團隊提早完成。

similar.diff: suggest 語氣較輕，多是提出想法；recommend 帶有專業判斷與推薦意味

example.en: I suggest meeting again after the product test.
example.zh: 我建議在產品測試後再開一次會。

similar.diff: advise 是給出專業意見，後接人 + to V

example.en: The lawyer advised us to review the contract again.
example.zh: 律師建議我們再審閱一次合約。

example.en: We propose a three-month trial of the new system.
example.zh: 我們提議為新系統進行為期三個月的試用。

example.en: Both options cost about the same amount of money.
example.zh: 這兩個選項的花費差不多。

senses.en: to say that someone or something is good for a purpose

example.en: Colleagues recommend this software for managing large projects.
example.zh: 同事們推薦這套軟體來管理大型專案。

senses.en: to advise that something should be done
senses.distinguish: 後接 that 子句或 V-ing

example.en: Doctors recommend that employees take short breaks every hour.
example.zh: 醫師建議員工每小時短暫休息。

extra_vocab.en: how good or bad something is
extra_vocab.note: 文中 our quality team 指品質部門；quality 在此當名詞修飾 team，表示負責品質檢驗與確認的團隊。說話者說已向品質團隊確認過測試的看法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: quality 當「品質」是不可數名詞；當「特質」時是可數名詞（qualities）。

example.en: She has the leadership qualities we need in this role.
example.zh: 她具備這個職位所需要的領導特質。

example.en: Quality control checks every batch before it leaves the factory.
example.zh: 品質管制會在每批貨出廠前進行檢查。

example.en: We only buy high-quality materials from certified suppliers.
example.zh: 我們只向有認證的供應商購買高品質的材料。

example.en: The quality assurance team approved the final prototype yesterday.
example.zh: 品保團隊昨天核准了最終原型。

examples.en: Customers expect good quality at a fair price.
examples.zh: 客戶期待合理的價格與良好的品質。

examples.en: The quality of the fabric dropped after we changed suppliers.
examples.zh: 換了供應商之後，布料的品質下降了。

confusable.diff: quantity 是「數量」，拼法與發音和 quality 很像

example.en: Please confirm the quantity before we place the order.
example.zh: 下訂單前請先確認數量。

confusable.diff: qualify 是動詞「具備資格」，拼法與 quality 相近

example.en: Applicants must qualify for the program before they enroll.
example.zh: 申請者在註冊前必須先符合這項計畫的資格。

example.en: This grade of steel is used for bridges.
example.zh: 這種等級的鋼材用於建造橋梁。

example.en: Inspectors found a defect in one of the units.
example.zh: 檢驗員在其中一台中發現了瑕疵。

derived.link: qual- 詞幹 + -ify（使成為），像 simplify
qualify 去 y 加 -ication，像 apply → application
quality 的形容詞形，與 quantitative（數量上的）相對

example.en: The inspector found no problems with the product quality.
example.zh: 檢驗員沒有發現產品品質有任何問題。

example.en: We sell quality furniture at very reasonable prices.
example.zh: 我們以非常合理的價格販售優質家具。

senses.en: the level of how good something is

example.en: Our goal is to keep quality high while reducing costs.
example.zh: 我們的目標是在降低成本的同時維持高品質。

senses.distinguish: 可數名詞，常用複數 qualities

example.en: Honesty is a quality every manager should have.
example.zh: 誠實是每位主管都該具備的特質。

extra_vocab.en: to need something, or to say something must be done
extra_vocab.note: 文中 this specific test may not be required 用被動語態，表示這項特定測試可能「不需要進行」。be required 在規定、測試與公告中很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: require + 名詞（需要…）；require + 人 + to V（要求某人做…），被動為 be required to V；require that 後的動詞用原形。

example.en: This job requires at least two years of sales experience.
example.zh: 這份工作需要至少兩年的業務經驗。

example.en: The contract required a signature from both parties.
example.zh: 這份合約需要雙方簽名。

example.en: Please bring all required documents to the interview.
example.zh: 請把所有必要文件帶來面試。

example.en: Orders requiring special packaging take longer to process.
example.zh: 需要特殊包裝的訂單處理時間較長。

example.en: Purchases over five hundred dollars require approval from a manager.
example.zh: 超過五百美元的採購需要主管核准。

example.en: Visitors are required to sign in at the front desk.
example.zh: 訪客必須在櫃檯簽到。

example.en: Our staff can provide extra training as required.
example.zh: 我們的人員可依需要提供額外訓練。

examples.en: Does the new system require special training for staff?
examples.zh: 新系統需要讓員工接受特別訓練嗎？

examples.en: Large orders require a deposit before we start production.
examples.zh: 大宗訂單在我們開始生產前需要先付訂金。

confusable.diff: request 是「請求」，語氣較客氣；require 是「規定、需要」，較強制

example.en: You may request a refund within thirty days of purchase.
example.zh: 您可以在購買後三十天內要求退款。

confusable.diff: acquire 是「取得、收購」，字尾 -quire 與 require 相同，容易混淆

example.en: The firm plans to acquire two smaller competitors.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫收購兩家規模較小的競爭對手。

similar.diff: need 較口語，主詞多為人；require 較正式，也可由規定、事物當主詞

example.en: Staff need approval before booking any international flights.
example.zh: 員工在預訂國際航班前需要核准。

similar.diff: call for 表示「需要、呼籲」，語氣較口語

example.en: This problem calls for a quick decision from management.
example.zh: 這個問題需要管理階層迅速做出決定。

example.en: Customers now demand faster delivery times than before.
example.zh: 客戶現在要求比以前更快的送貨時間。

example.en: Safety training is mandatory for all new hires.
example.zh: 安全訓練對所有新進員工都是強制的。

senses.en: to need something in order to do or be something
senses.distinguish: 主詞多為事物，被動 be required 也表示「需要」

example.en: Installing this machine does not require any special tools.
example.zh: 安裝這台機器不需要任何特殊工具。

senses.en: to make someone do something by rule or law
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人時，後接 to V

example.en: The law requires companies to keep records for five years.
example.zh: 法律規定公司必須保存紀錄五年。
